note: Agent-proposed bounded WP4B envelope (slice 2 of WP4); see docs/workstreams/wp4b-schema-registry-v1alpha4.md.

fixtures.title: Positive exact Schema closure including San compile
fixtures.input: Valid Request Schema plus the Appendix E trusted external Context Schema; all G.4-valid and exactly resolvable.
assertions: The external Context Schema closure is resolved and compiled by San without ambient loading.

fixtures.title: External Schema $ref does not resolve
fixtures.input: Nested Schema property $ref to an unregistered absolute Schema $id.
assertions: Exactly one SCHEMA_MISSING is emitted for the external resource.
No target is guessed from a filename, prefix or order.
The diagnostic uses empty path and zero location.

fixtures.title: Cyclic external Schema $ref chain
fixtures.input: Two external Schemas whose root $ref chain returns to the first Schema.
assertions: The cycle is rejected as SCHEMA_INVALID.
No arbitrary recursive expansion is performed.

fixtures.title: Host Context root collision
fixtures.input: Host Context effective root open (additionalProperties true) or declaring the reserved request property.
assertions: No omitted/optional treatment of the reserved property.

fixtures.title: Missing external Context Schema is diagnosed once
fixtures.input: Contract.contextSchema references a missing external Schema $id.
assertions: Exactly one SCHEMA_MISSING is emitted (WP3B owns the reference identity).
WP4B does not duplicate the reference diagnostic.
The diagnostic retains the Contract source location.

fixtures.title: San adapter accepts only pre-registered G.4-valid resources
fixtures.input: In-memory external Schema closure with a root $ref to a registered leaf Schema.
assertions: San compiles the registered closure without ambient loading.
The adapter never broadens the G.4 keyword set.
